_README: Permissions are narrow on git, per the house rule 'A gate an agent can skip
is not a gate. If a bypass flag exists, it is a human judgment call. Refuse
it to the agent and leave it in the person's own terminal.'
There is no blanket Bash(git commit:*). The allowed forms cannot carry
--no-verify, which would skip .githooks/pre-commit. Deny beats allow, so
'git push origin main' stays refused although 'git push origin' is allowed;
.githooks/pre-push refuses refs/heads/main as well.
wrangler d1: only the form 'npx wrangler d1 execute --local ...' is allowed,
with --local written straight after 'execute'. Remote D1 writes need a person.
Credential files: the Read denies keep Claude's file tools, the file commands
it recognizes in Bash (cat, head, sed, redirects) and edits off .env files,
secrets/, keys, ~/.ssh, ~/.aws and Wrangler's .dev.vars. ./ is the session's
directory and ~/ is home (code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions, read
2026-11-03). A script that opens files itself is not stopped; the house key
rules still apply. ./.env covers only the start directory, so ./**/.env
adds site/.env and any other one below it.
Two hooks are wired here, and this file is the authority on that wiring:
PostToolUse Write|Edit -> .claude/hooks/cs-site-content-guard.sh (fires on
every edit; advisory, exit 2 on a FAIL shows Claude the findings)
SessionStart -> .claude/hooks/cs-site-session-start.sh (fires at session
start; sets core.hooksPath=.githooks if unset, then routes to
scripts/worktree_deps.py, which seeds a new worktree's node_modules)
04_tools/contract_test.py C4, C5 and C8 check this file against the hook
headers, the deny list and the gate table in .claude/rules/site-gates.md.
Merging: 'gh pr merge' is allowed (Paul, 2026-10-18, decision 56). The
orchestrator reviews and merges with --match-head-commit and a literal SHA;
lanes never merge (00_project_system/BRIEF.md section 4). The Claude-OS bash
guard still refuses --auto, --admin and merges without a literal SHA.
Deploys, secrets and remote D1: the orchestrator may run them (Paul,
2026-10-18, decision 57). Lanes still never deploy, set secrets or write
remote data (00_project_system/BRIEF.md section 4). Gate B passed on 2026-10-18.
